case.case_title: Wickrematunga v. Anuruddha Ratwatte and Others
case.source_citation: Supreme Court of Sri Lanka, S.C. Application No. F.R. 228/96, decided on 17 December 1997

clause.text: Certain long-term residents are entitled to these rights for ten years.

case_context.legal_issue: Whether Article 14(2) was materially engaged in the Court's reasoning or holding regarding the petitioner's fundamental rights claim.

link_explanation.why_this_clause_matters: Article 14(2) was not materially engaged or interpreted in the Court's reasoning or holding; the case focused on Article 14(1)(g) and Article 12(2).

evidence.evidence_excerpt: The Court granted leave and proceeded on alleged violations of Articles 12(2) and 14(1)(g); Article 14(2) was not discussed or applied.
